text:
1. 15. 28. 

Aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ manosucaritasamaṅgī tannidānā tappaccayā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyya, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. Ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ manosucaritasamaṅgī tannidānā tappaccayā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyya, ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti. 

(Aṭṭhānapāḷi niṭṭhitā)

16. Ekadhammapāḷi
